name: rentz
description: RentZ monorepo - run everything locally without Docker for fast testing/iteration

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/listing-service && npm install --prefix services/media-service && npm install --prefix services/location-service && npm install --prefix services/inquiry-service && npm install --prefix gateway && npm install --prefix apps/public-app && npm install --prefix apps/owner-app
scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,listing,media,location,inquiry,gateway,public,owner -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan,white,gray,red "npm run dev --prefix services/auth-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/listing-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/media-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/location-service" "npm run dev --prefix services/inquiry-service" "npm run dev --prefix gateway" "npm run dev --prefix apps/public-app" "npm run dev --prefix apps/owner-app"
